architecture: AO bytes plus one-time base64 for new PNG at final MCP boundary
default_step: actual prior V if supplied -> local predict_action -> execute/readback -> actual A -> after/Outcome/new image

comparisons.B: Same engine, content, causal order and relay/pump/IPC; reasonable manual thin orchestration
comparisons.I: Candidate typed tool orchestration on the same thin transport
comparisons.L: Same resident new engine/content/order reasonably wrapped through existing Blender MCP execute_code; no artificial old guard or per-call session rebuild

first_delivery: Minimal new implementation files + precise API/protocol draft + CPU transport/semantic checks + at most two preregistered independent Blender functional processes (one background, one isolated hidden GUI), <=6 tasks per process; no formal benchmark or paid model API
not_adopted_from_reviewer_proposals: Mandatory prepare/commit confirmation for every explicit command
Assuming >=30% total wire-byte reduction against a baseline that already sends only new images
Treating headless tests as live GUI scheduling or real MCP host qualification
historical_evidence_limits: Some recent private verification/fixes records absent; report-only timings are labelled; local tokenizer and fixed image estimates are not provider usage
